selectedFunctions.label: Add caller-owned token pair liquidity
warnings: Static source/ABI admission only; no runtime identity persistence, live availability, funded execution, backing, yield, TVL, legal eligibility or financial-safety assurance; existing grants and pause controls still apply.
Own Ethereum JMSwapLiquidityRouter only, not swap aggregator, bridge, spot-order router, Tron, BitTorrent, BNB or Polygon. Direct immutable router, no proxy implementation path in recovered source.

Explorer labels router Unverified. Full ABI/source was recovered from deployed runtime embedded IPFS metadata, with metadata CID and source Keccak hashes resolved; compiler reproducibility/bytecode equivalence has not been established.

factory and WBASE are immutable; current reads identify factory 0xd36aba9ec96523b0a89886c76065852adfe2eb39 and Ethereum WETH 0xc02aaa39b223fe8d0a0e5c4f27ead9083c756cc2. Pair init-code hash is fixed in source; factory/pair/token dependencies are not independently runtime-attested.

Liquidity funding always pulls caller assets or LP under preexisting allowances; pair mint/burn changes own financial LP accounting. No approvals, permits or raw prefund/public-mint workaround is added. Selected receiver can differ from caller.

Desired/minimum amounts use raw token units, LP amount uses pair LP units, deadline is a Unix timestamp; deadlines are checked, but source minimum checks are asymmetric for adding liquidity and absent on initial empty-pool desired amounts, not a general received-amount/slippage guarantee.

Router forwards its entire token balances on add and removal, including incidental dust/donations. Never prefund it as a separate workflow. Taxed tokens can charge multiple transfers; removal minimums are checked against pair-reported nominal amounts, not final recipient net receipts.

Native add wraps used msg.value and refunds unused ETH to caller; native removal unwraps WETH and sends ETH to designated receiver. Receiver/caller contracts must accept ETH where relevant. Reserves, pricing, taxes, rounding, liquidity and token behavior can cause loss or failure.
